where: Thaddeus Blackthorn's study: dark panelling, a mahogany desk heaped with ledgers and maps before a tall window on moonlit Kordavos, velvet curtains half drawn. Shelves of scrolls along the west wall, a glass cabinet of trinkets in the corner, a hearth on the east wall with an ornate sword over it, and a tapestry hiding a second door. The party has just come in by the door.
